Category.name: quantext
Category.description: Functions to construct and use QuantExt FX indexes, FX-linked cashflows and cross-currency swaps.

Parameter.name: FamilyName
Parameter.description: index family name (e.g. ECB).

Parameter.name: FixingDays
Parameter.description: fixing days (e.g. 2).

Parameter.name: SourceCurrency
Parameter.description: source currency (e.g. EUR); the index value is units of target per unit of source.

Parameter.name: TargetCurrency
Parameter.description: target currency (e.g. USD).

Parameter.name: FixingCalendar
Parameter.description: fixing calendar (e.g. TARGET).

Parameter.name: FxSpot
Parameter.description: FX spot quote (target per unit of source, immediate settlement).

Parameter.name: SourceYieldCurve
Parameter.description: source currency discount curve used to forecast fixings.

Parameter.name: TargetYieldCurve
Parameter.description: target currency discount curve used to forecast fixings.

Parameter.name: FixingTriangulation
Parameter.description: TRUE to allow fixings to be derived by inversion/triangulation of other FX index fixings.

Member.name: qlFxIndexSourceCurrency
Member.description: Returns the source currency (e.g. EUR) for the given FxIndex object.

Member.name: qlFxIndexTargetCurrency
Member.description: Returns the target currency (e.g. USD) for the given FxIndex object.

Parameter.name: CashFlowDates
Parameter.description: payment dates, one per QuantExt::FXLinkedCashFlow.

Parameter.name: FixingDates
Parameter.description: FX fixing dates, one per cashflow.

Parameter.name: ForeignAmounts
Parameter.description: amounts in the FX index source (foreign) currency, one per cashflow; each cashflow pays ForeignAmount x FxIndex fixing.

Parameter.name: FxIndex
Parameter.description: FxIndex object ID converting the foreign amounts into the leg currency.

Parameter.name: UnderlyingLeg
Parameter.description: floating rate Leg object ID (e.g. from qlIborLeg); every cashflow must be a floating rate coupon. Its nominals are ignored.

Parameter.name: FxFixingDates
Parameter.description: FX fixing dates, one per coupon of the underlying leg.

Parameter.name: ForeignAmount
Parameter.description: notional in the FX index source (foreign) currency; each coupon nominal is ForeignAmount x FxIndex fixing.

Parameter.name: FxIndex
Parameter.description: FxIndex object ID converting the foreign notional into the leg currency.

Parameter.name: LegIDs
Parameter.description: leg object IDs.

Parameter.name: Payer
Parameter.description: TRUE for payed leg, one per leg.

Parameter.name: Currencies
Parameter.description: leg currencies (e.g. EUR), one per leg.

Parameter.name: IsPhysicallySettled
Parameter.description: TRUE if the swap is physically settled.

Parameter.name: IsResettable
Parameter.description: TRUE if the swap has a resetting (mark-to-market) notional.

Member.name: qlCurrencySwapLegNPV
Member.description: Returns the NPV, in the engine NPV currency, of the i-th leg of the given CurrencySwap object.

Parameter.name: LegNumber
Parameter.description: zero based leg number.

Member.name: qlCurrencySwapInCcyLegNPV
Member.description: Returns the NPV, in the leg currency, of the i-th leg of the given CurrencySwap object.

Parameter.name: LegNumber
Parameter.description: zero based leg number.

Member.name: qlCurrencySwapLegCurrency
Member.description: Returns the currency of the i-th leg of the given CurrencySwap object.

Parameter.name: LegNumber
Parameter.description: zero based leg number.
